name: toeplitz
expr: T1 = toeplitz([1 2 3 4]); T2 = toeplitz([1 2 3], [1 4 5 6]); T3 = toeplitz([1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8]); Tc = toeplitz([1+1i 2+2i 3+3i]); tc11r = real(Tc(1,1)); tc11i = imag(Tc(1,1)); tc21r = real(Tc(2,1)); tc21i = imag(Tc(2,1)); tc12r = real(Tc(1,2)); tc12i = imag(Tc(1,2)); Tr = toeplitz([1+1i 2 3],[1-9i 8 7]); tr11r = real(Tr(1,1)); tr11i = imag(Tr(1,1)); tr21r = real(Tr(2,1)); tr12 = real(Tr(1,2)); Ts = toeplitz(single([1 2 3])); ts_is = double(strcmp(class(Ts),'single')); ts21 = double(Ts(2,1));
comment: Sig: T = toeplitz(c[, r]). T[i,j] = c[i-j] (i>=j) else r[j-i]; r[0] silently overridden by c[0]. DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: was DOUBLE-only — dropped the imaginary part of COMPLEX inputs and down-converted SINGLE to double. Now preserves COMPLEX (per-element gather) and SINGLE class. Single-arg COMPLEX form is a HERMITIAN Toeplitz: MATLAB conjugates the strictly-lower triangle, so toeplitz([1+1i 2+2i 3+3i]) has Tc(2,1)=conj(2+2i)=2-2i but Tc(1,2)=2+2i; two-arg complex is a plain gather (no conjugation, Tr(2,1)=c(2)=2). char/logical rejected by MATLAB (not added here). Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b across square + rectangular + complex + single probes.
